# sgraph_from_atoms { #mofography.analyze.sgraph_from_atoms }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Standard NetworkX bond graph from covalent_bonds on ASE Atoms.

```python
analyze.sgraph_from_atoms(ase_atoms, node_props_dict=None, edge_props_dict=None)
```

Build a NetworkX bond graph from ``ase_atoms.info['covalent_bonds']`` with optional node/edge props.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                  | Default    |
|-----------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms       |        | ASE atoms object                                                                                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| node_props_dict |        | A dictionary of node properties. The keys are the property names and the values are the property values. The values should be a list of length equal to the number of atoms in the structure | `None`     |
| edge_props_dict |        | A dictionary of edge properties. The keys are the property names and the values are the property values. The values should be a list of length equal to the number of edges in the graph     | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description              |
|--------|--------|--------------------------|
|        |        | A networkx graph object. |
